scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n client,server,assets -c green,blue,yellow "npm run dev -w @orchard/client" "npm run dev -w @orchard/server" "npm run watch -w @orchard/tools"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @orchard/sim && npm run build -w @orchard/tools && npm run build -w @orchard/client && npm run build -w @orchard/server
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run assets:validate
